verses.text: One man dey for di hill country of Ephraim, im name na Micah.

E talk to im mama say, “Di 1,100 pieces of silver wey dem take from you, wey you curse and still speak am for my ear—look, di silver dey with me. Na me take am.” Im mama talk say, “Make di Lord bless my pikin man!”

E return di 1,100 pieces of silver to im mama, and im mama talk say, “I don dedicate di silver to di Lord from my hand for my pikin man, to make carved image and molten image. So now I go return am to you.”
When e return di money to im mama, im mama take 200 pieces of silver, and give dem to one silversmith, wey make carved image and molten image from am. E dey inside Micah house.
Dis man Micah get one house of gods, and e make ephod and teraphim, and consecrate one of im pikin man dem, wey become im priest.
For dem days, no king dey for Israel. Everybody dey do wetin dey right for im own eyes.
One young man dey from Bethlehem Judah, from di family of Judah, and e na Levite; and e dey live dere.
Di man leave di city, Bethlehem Judah, to go live wia e fit find place; and as e dey travel, e reach di hill country of Ephraim, Micah house.
Micah talk to am say, “Wia you come from?” E talk to am say, “I na Levite from Bethlehem Judah, and I dey go live wia I fit find place.”
Micah talk to am say, “Live with me, and be papa and priest to me, and I go give you ten pieces of silver every year, one set of clothes, and your food.” So di Levite go in.
Di Levite agree to live with di man; and di young man dey to am like one of im pikin man dem.
Micah consecrate di Levite; di young man become im priest, and e dey for Micah house.
Den Micah talk say, “Now I know say di Lord go do me good, because I get Levite as my priest.”
For dem days, no king dey for Israel. For dem days, di tribe of Dan dey find inheritance to live inside; because till dat day, dem inheritance never fall to dem among di tribes of Israel.

Di pikin dem of Dan send five men from dem family, from dem whole number, men of valour, from Zorah and from Eshtaol, to spy out di land and search am; and dem talk to dem say, “Go, explore di land.” Dem come to di hill country of Ephraim, to Micah house, and sleep dere.
When dem reach near Micah house, dem know di voice of di young man, di Levite; and dem turn go dere, and talk to am say, “Who bring you come here? Wetin you dey do for dis place? Wetin you get here?”
E talk to dem say, “Micah do me like dis and like dis, and e don hire me, and I don become im priest.”
Dem talk to am say, “Please, ask God for counsel, so that we go know whether di journey wey we dey go go prosper.”
Di priest talk to dem say, “Go in peace. Di journey wey una dey go dey before di Lord.”

Den di five men leave, and reach Laish, and see di people wey dey inside am, how dem dey live in safety, like di Sidonians, quiet and secure; because nobody dey for di land wey get authority to put dem to shame for anything, and dem dey far from di Sidonians, and dem no get dealings with anybody.
Dem come to dem brothers for Zorah and Eshtaol; and dem brothers talk to dem say, “Wetin una talk?”
Dem talk say, “Rise, make we go up against dem; because we don see di land, and look, e very good. Una dey sit still? No dey slow to go enter and possess di land.
When una go, una go meet people wey no suspect anything, and di land wide; because God don give am into una hand, one place wia dem no lack anything wey dey for di earth.”
600 men wey carry weapons of war set out from dere, from di family of Dan, from Zorah and from Eshtaol.
Dem go up, and camp for Kiriath Jearim, for Judah. Na why dem call dat place Mahaneh Dan till today. Look, e dey behind Kiriath Jearim.
Dem pass from dere go di hill country of Ephraim, and reach Micah house.
Den di five men wey go spy out di country of Laish answer, talk to dem brothers say, “Una know say ephod, teraphim, carved image and molten image dey inside dis houses? So now think wetin una go do.”
Dem turn go dere, and come to di house of di young man, di Levite, na Micah house, and ask am about im welfare.
Di 600 men wey carry dem weapons of war, wey be pikin dem of Dan, stand by di entrance of di gate.

Di five men wey go spy out di land go up, enter dere, and take di carved image, di ephod, di teraphim, and di molten image, while di priest stand by di entrance of di gate with di 600 men wey carry weapons of war.
When dem enter Micah house, and take di carved image, di ephod, di teraphim, and di molten image, di priest talk to dem say, “Wetin una dey do?”

Dem talk to am say, “Keep quiet, put your hand on your mouth, and follow us, and be papa and priest to us. E better for you to be priest for di house of one man, or to be priest for one tribe and family for Israel?”
Di priest heart glad, and e take di ephod, di teraphim, and di carved image, and go among di people.
So dem turn and leave, and put di small pikin dem, di livestock and di goods before dem.
When dem don go far from Micah house, di men wey dey di houses near Micah house gather together, and catch up with di pikin dem of Dan.
Dem shout to di pikin dem of Dan. Dem turn dem face, and talk to Micah say, “Wetin dey wrong with you, wey you come with dis kind company?”
E talk say, “Una don carry my gods wey I make, and di priest, and go. Wetin I still get? How una fit ask me, ‘Wetin dey wrong with you?’”
Di pikin dem of Dan talk to am say, “Make your voice no dey hear among us, because angry men fit fall on you, and you go lose your life with di lives of your household.”
Di pikin dem of Dan go dem way; and when Micah see say dem strong pass am, e turn go back to im house.
Dem take wetin Micah make, and di priest wey e get, and come to Laish, to people wey quiet and secure, and strike dem with di edge of di sword; and dem burn di city with fire.
Nobody deliver dem, because e far from Sidon, and dem no get dealings with anybody; and e dey for di valley wey dey by Beth Rehob. Dem build di city, and live inside am.
Dem call di name of di city Dan, after di name of Dan dem papa, wey Israel born; but for di beginning, di name of di city na Laish.

Di pikin dem of Dan set up di carved image for demself; and Jonathan di pikin of Gershom, di pikin of Moses, e and im pikin man dem na priests to di tribe of Dan until di day of di captivity of di land.
So dem set up Micah carved image wey e make for demself, all di time wey God house dey for Shiloh.
For dem days, when no king dey for Israel, one Levite dey live for di far side of di hill country of Ephraim, wey take one concubine for imself from Bethlehem Judah.
Im concubine play di prostitute against am, and leave am go im papa house for Bethlehem Judah, and dey dere for four months.

Im husband rise, and go after am, to speak kindly to am and bring am back, with im servant and two donkeys dey with am. Di woman bring am enter im papa house; and when di young woman papa see am, e rejoice to meet am.
Im papa-in-law, di young woman papa, hold am; and e stay with am three days: so dem eat and drink, and stay dere.

For di fourth day, dem rise early for morning, and e stand up to leave: and di young woman papa talk to im pikin-in-law say, “Strengthen your heart with small bread, and after dat you go go your way.”
So dem sit down, and eat and drink, di two of dem together: and di young woman papa talk to di man say, “Please agree, stay for night, and make your heart dey merry.”
Di man rise to leave; but im papa-in-law press am, and e stay dere again.
E rise early for morning for di fifth day to leave; and di young woman papa talk say, “Please, strengthen your heart, and wait until di day dey go down;” and di two of dem eat.

When di man rise to leave, e and im concubine and im servant, im papa-in-law, di young woman papa, talk to am say, “Look, di day don dey go toward evening, please stay for night. Look, di day dey end, stay here, so that your heart go dey merry; and tomorrow, go your way early, so that you go reach house.”
But di man no wan stay dat night, e rise and leave, and reach opposite Jebus, wey na Jerusalem. Two donkeys wey dem don saddle dey with am. Im concubine dey with am too.
When dem dey near Jebus, di day don go far; and di servant talk to im oga say, “Please come, make we turn enter dis city of di Jebusites, and pass di night inside am.”
Im oga talk to am say, “We no go turn enter di city of foreigner wey no be of di pikin dem of Israel; but we go pass go Gibeah.”
E talk to im servant say, “Come, make we go near one of dis places; and we go pass di night for Gibeah, or for Ramah.”
So dem pass on and go dem way; and sun set on dem near Gibeah, wey belong to Benjamin.
Dem turn go dere, to enter pass di night for Gibeah. E enter, sit down for di street of di city: because nobody take dem enter im house to pass di night.
Look, one old man come from im work for di field for evening. Di man na from di hill country of Ephraim, and e dey live for Gibeah; but di men of dat place na pikin dem of Benjamin.
E lift up im eyes, and see di traveller for di street of di city; and di old man talk say, “Wia you dey go? Wia you come from?”

E talk to am say, “We dey pass from Bethlehem Judah go di far side of di hill country of Ephraim. Na from dere I come, and I go Bethlehem Judah. Now I dey go di Lord house; and nobody don take me enter im house.
But straw and feed dey for our donkeys; and bread and wine dey for me too, and for your servant, and for di young man wey dey with your servants. We no lack anything.”
Di old man talk say, “Peace dey with you! Make I provide all wetin you need; just no pass di night for di street.”
So e bring am enter im house, and give di donkeys fodder: and dem wash dem feet, and eat and drink.

As dem dey make dem heart merry, look, di men of di city, some wicked men, surround di house, dey beat di door; and dem speak to di oga of di house, di old man, talk say, “Bring out di man wey enter your house, so that we go sleep with am.”
Di man, di oga of di house, go out to dem, and talk to dem say, “No, my brothers, please no do evil like dis; since dis man don enter my house, no do dis foolishness.
Look, my virgin pikin woman dey here, and im concubine. I go bring dem out now. Humiliate dem, and do with dem wetin good for your eyes; but to dis man, no do any foolishness like dis.”
But di men no wan listen to am: so di man seize im concubine, and bring am out to dem; and dem sleep with am, and abuse am all di night until morning: and when day begin break, dem let am go.
Den di woman come when day dey break, and fall down for di door of di man house wia im oga dey, until e don light.
Im oga rise for morning, open di doors of di house, and go out to continue im journey; and look, di woman im concubine don fall down for di door of di house, with im hands on di threshold.
E talk to am say, “Get up, make we go;” but nobody answer. Den e put am on di donkey; and di man rise, and go to im place.
When e reach im house, e take knife, hold im concubine, and cut am up, limb by limb, into 12 pieces, and send am go all di borders of Israel.

E come be say everybody wey see am talk say, “Dem never do or see dis kind thing from di day wey di pikin dem of Israel come out of di land of Egypt till today! Think about am, take counsel, and speak.”
Den all di pikin dem of Israel go out, and di congregation gather together like one man, from Dan reach Beersheba, with di land of Gilead, to di Lord for Mizpah.
Di chiefs of all di people, even of all di tribes of Israel, present demself for di assembly of God people, 400,000 foot soldiers wey draw sword.
Now di pikin dem of Benjamin hear say di pikin dem of Israel don go up to Mizpah. Di pikin dem of Israel talk say, “Tell us, how dis wickedness take happen?”
Di Levite, di husband of di woman wey dem murder, answer, talk say, “I and my concubine come to Gibeah wey belong to Benjamin, to pass di night.
Di men of Gibeah rise against me, and surround di house for night against me. Dem wan kill me, and dem rape my concubine, and e don die.
I take my concubine, cut am into pieces, and send am go all di country of di inheritance of Israel; because dem don do lewdness and foolishness for Israel.
Look, una all na pikin dem of Israel; give una advice and counsel here.”
All di people rise like one man, talk say, “Nobody among us go go im tent, and nobody go turn go im house.
But now dis na di thing wey we go do to Gibeah: we go go up against am by lot;

and we go take ten men out of every 100 for all di tribes of Israel, and 100 out of every 1,000, and 1,000 out of every 10,000 to get food for di people, so that dem fit do, when dem reach Gibeah of Benjamin, according to all di foolishness wey dem do for Israel.”
So all di men of Israel gather against di city, joined together like one man.
Di tribes of Israel send men go all di tribe of Benjamin, talk say, “Wetin be dis wickedness wey happen among una?
So now deliver up di men, di wicked men wey dey Gibeah, so that we go put dem to death, and remove evil from Israel.” But Benjamin no wan listen to di voice of dem brothers, di pikin dem of Israel.
Di pikin dem of Benjamin gather demself together from di cities to Gibeah, to go out to battle against di pikin dem of Israel.
Dem count di pikin dem of Benjamin dat day from di cities, 26,000 men wey draw sword, apart from di people of Gibeah, wey dem count 700 chosen men.
Among all dis people, 700 chosen men dey wey be left-handed; every one of dem fit sling stone at one hair, and no miss.
Dem count di men of Israel, apart from Benjamin, 400,000 men wey draw sword: all dis ones na men of war.

Di pikin dem of Israel rise, go up to Bethel, and ask God for counsel; and dem talk say, “Who go go up first for us to battle against di pikin dem of Benjamin?” Di Lord talk say, “Judah go go up first.”
Di pikin dem of Israel rise for morning, and camp against Gibeah.
Di men of Israel go out to battle against Benjamin; and di men of Israel arrange di battle against dem for Gibeah.
Di pikin dem of Benjamin come out of Gibeah, and dat day destroy 22,000 men of Israel to di ground.
Di people, di men of Israel, encourage demself, and arrange di battle again for di place wia dem arrange demself di first day.

Di pikin dem of Israel go up and weep before di Lord until evening; and dem ask di Lord, talk say, “Make I go near again to battle against di pikin dem of Benjamin my brother?” Di Lord talk say, “Go up against am.”
Di pikin dem of Israel come near against di pikin dem of Benjamin di second day.
Benjamin go out against dem from Gibeah di second day, and destroy 18,000 men of di pikin dem of Israel to di ground again; all dis ones draw sword.

Den all di pikin dem of Israel, and all di people, go up, come to Bethel, weep, sit dere before di Lord, and fast dat day until evening; and dem offer burnt offerings and peace offerings before di Lord.
Di pikin dem of Israel ask di Lord, because di ark of di covenant of God dey dere for dem days,

and Phinehas di pikin of Eleazar, di pikin of Aaron, dey stand before am for dem days, talk say, “Make I go out again to battle against di pikin dem of Benjamin my brother, or make I stop?” Di Lord talk say, “Go up; because tomorrow I go deliver am into your hand.”
Israel set ambushers against Gibeah all round.
Di pikin dem of Israel go up against di pikin dem of Benjamin di third day, and arrange demself against Gibeah, like di other times.

Di pikin dem of Benjamin go out against di people, and dem draw dem away from di city; and dem begin strike and kill some of di people, like di other times, for di highways, wey one go up to Bethel, and di other go to Gibeah, for di field, about 30 men of Israel.
Di pikin dem of Benjamin talk say, “Dem don strike dem down before us, like di first.” But di pikin dem of Israel talk say, “Make we run, and draw dem away from di city to di highways.”
All di men of Israel rise from dem place, and arrange demself for Baal Tamar; and di ambushers of Israel burst out from dem place, even from Maareh Geba.
10,000 chosen men from all Israel come against Gibeah, and di battle hard; but dem no know say disaster don near dem.
Di Lord strike Benjamin before Israel; and di pikin dem of Israel destroy 25,100 men of Benjamin dat day: all dis ones draw sword.
So di pikin dem of Benjamin see say dem don strike dem down; because di men of Israel give way to Benjamin, because dem trust di ambushers wey dem set against Gibeah.
Di ambushers hurry, rush enter Gibeah; and di ambushers spread out, strike all di city with di edge of di sword.
Now di sign wey dem agree between di men of Israel and di ambushers na say dem go make big cloud of smoke rise up from di city.
Di men of Israel turn for di battle, and Benjamin begin strike and kill about 30 men of Israel; because dem talk say, “Surely dem don fall before us, like di first battle.”
But when di cloud begin rise from di city like pillar of smoke, di men of Benjamin look behind dem; and look, di whole city dey go up as smoke to heaven.
Di men of Israel turn, and di men of Benjamin dey afraid; because dem see say disaster don reach dem.
So dem turn dem back before di men of Israel go di way of di wilderness; but di battle follow dem close; and dem wey come out of di cities destroy dem for di middle of am.
Dem surround di men of Benjamin, chase dem, and trample dem down for dem resting place, reach near Gibeah toward where sun dey rise.
18,000 men of Benjamin fall; all dis ones na men of valour.
Dem turn run go di wilderness to di rock of Rimmon: and dem gather 5,000 men of dem for di highways, follow dem close reach Gidom, and kill 2,000 men of dem.
So all wey fall dat day from Benjamin na 25,000 men wey draw sword; all dis ones na men of valour.
But 600 men turn run go di wilderness to di rock of Rimmon, and live for di rock of Rimmon four months.

Di men of Israel turn again on di pikin dem of Benjamin, and strike dem with di edge of di sword, include di whole city, di livestock and all wey dem find: moreover dem set fire to all di cities wey dem find.
Now di men of Israel don swear for Mizpah, talk say, “Nobody among us go give im pikin woman to Benjamin as wife.”
Di people come to Bethel, sit dere until evening before God, lift up dem voice, and weep bitterly.
Dem talk say, “Di Lord, God of Israel, why dis thing happen for Israel, so that one tribe dey missing from Israel today?”
Di next day, di people rise early, build altar dere, and offer burnt offerings and peace offerings.

Di pikin dem of Israel talk say, “Who among all di tribes of Israel no come up to di assembly before di Lord?” Because dem don make big oath about anybody wey no come up to di Lord for Mizpah, talk say, “Dem go surely put am to death.”
Di pikin dem of Israel grieve for Benjamin dem brother, and talk say, “Dem don cut off one tribe from Israel today.
Wetin we go do for di ones wey remain, to get wives, since we don swear by di Lord say we no go give dem any of our pikin woman dem as wives?”
Dem talk say, “Who among di tribes of Israel no come up to di Lord for Mizpah?” Look, nobody come from Jabesh Gilead to di camp for di assembly.
Because when dem count di people, look, none of di people wey dey Jabesh Gilead dey dere.
Di congregation send 12,000 of di bravest men go dere, and command dem, talk say, “Go strike di people wey dey Jabesh Gilead with di edge of di sword, with di women and di small pikin dem.
Dis na wetin una go do: una go utterly destroy every male, and every woman wey don sleep with man.”
Dem find among di people of Jabesh Gilead 400 young virgins wey never know man by sleeping with am; and dem bring dem to di camp for Shiloh, wey dey di land of Canaan.
Di whole congregation send speak to di pikin dem of Benjamin wey dey di rock of Rimmon, and proclaim peace to dem.
Benjamin return dat time; and dem give dem di women wey dem save alive from di women of Jabesh Gilead: but even so, dem no do enough for dem.
Di people grieve for Benjamin, because di Lord don make breach among di tribes of Israel.
Den di elders of di congregation talk say, “How we go provide wives for di ones wey remain, since dem don destroy di women from Benjamin?”
Dem talk say, “Inheritance must dey for di ones wey escape from Benjamin, so that dem no go wipe one tribe out from Israel.
But we no fit give dem wives from our pikin woman dem, because di pikin dem of Israel don swear, talk say, ‘Curse dey on anybody wey give wife to Benjamin.’”
Dem talk say, “Look, feast of di Lord dey every year for Shiloh, wey dey north of Bethel, for east side of di highway wey dey go up from Bethel to Shechem, and for south of Lebonah.”
Dem command di pikin dem of Benjamin, talk say, “Go hide for di vineyards,

and watch, and look, if di pikin woman dem of Shiloh come out to dance for di dances, den una come out from di vineyards, and every man catch im wife from di pikin woman dem of Shiloh, and go di land of Benjamin.

E go happen say, when dem papa dem or dem brothers come complain to us, we go talk to dem say, ‘Please, give dem to us as favour, because we no take wife for every man for battle; and una no give dem to dem, otherwise una go dey guilty now.’”

Di pikin dem of Benjamin do so, and take wives for demself, according to dem number, from di ones wey dey dance, wey dem carry go. Dem go return to dem inheritance, build di cities, and live inside dem.
Di pikin dem of Israel leave from dere dat time, every man go im tribe and im family, and dem go out from dere every man to im inheritance.
For dem days, no king dey for Israel. Everybody dey do wetin dey right for im own eyes.
